summary: Validated backend rewrite from FastAPI to Django 5.1 + DRF + pymongo. All 12 existing pytest cases pass unchanged against the new Django ASGI backend (uvicorn server:app). API contract is identical to iteration_1. Frontend storefront catalogue loads (9 products), Bread category filter returns 3, end-to-end order placement against Django succeeds (Order received modal with reference ID shown). Admin login page renders with pre-filled admin@bakery.com.

minor.issue: admin_required uses @wraps on a bound method — works but decorator semantics a bit unusual; no functional impact.
Response merges existing+update but doesn't re-read from DB — harmless since update_one succeeded, but a post-write GET would be more defensive.

issues: Orders list cards still lack data-testid=order-row-{id} (noted in iteration_1, not addressed).

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="order-row-{id}" to admin order cards.
Optional: silence React Router v7 future-flag warnings (cosmetic).
Optional: implement brute-force lockout after 5 failed logins (playbook recommendation; not implemented).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly exposes Django ASGI as `app` with dotenv loaded before django.setup() — good.
auth_utils.admin_required decorator is clean; token extracted from cookie OR Bearer header (both paths tested & working).
views.py uniformly excludes Mongo `_id` via projection {"_id": 0} — no ObjectId leakage.
seed.py is idempotent: seed_admin re-hashes if password changes; seed_products skips when count>0; unique indexes on id/email.
Cookie: samesite=None + secure=True + httpOnly — correct for cross-site preview over HTTPS. Verified via set-cookie header assertion.
bcrypt hash format: $2b$ (verified by successful login round-trip).
CORS: django-cors-headers with allow_credentials and explicit origins expected; confirm in settings.py if any origin issue arises.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login or /api/orders — minor hardening gap.
test_credentials: admin@bakery.com / admin123 (works — tested via API and UI prefill)
seed_data_creation: Created 1 UI order (TEST UI Customer) + pytest created transient TEST_ product + 1 TEST order. Transient product was deleted; orders remain for admin visibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Django backend: uvicorn server:app, ASGI lifespan-unsupported warning is harmless. URL patterns in api/urls.py have NO trailing slashes (e.g. /api/products). Admin dashboard UI flow was thoroughly verified in iteration_1 and frontend code is unchanged; only backend swapped. Login form uses data-testid=login-email/login-password/login-submit (visually present; one Playwright run had a selector-visibility race — re-try with longer wait_for_load_state('networkidle') if needed). Admin dashboard testids: tab-products, tab-orders, new-product-btn, product-name, product-price, product-category (select), product-description, product-save-btn, product-row-{id}.
rca of the issue: No outstanding backend or integration bugs. Django rewrite preserves API contract; all pytest pass; storefront order placement works end-to-end against new backend.
